target_customer: Low-income high school graduates paying with Pell Grants
problem: College is too expensive for low-income students; DoF proposed a $9,000 one year and $18,000 two year hybrid program payable via Pell Grants.
business_model: Nonprofit tuition funded by Pell Grants plus philanthropy

founders.name: S. Aaron Andrew
prior_employers: White House, Senior Advisor for Education and Civic Technology (2013-2016)
founders.background_notes: VTDigger names the Democracy Builders leader as Seth Andrew, charged 27 Apr 2021 with wire fraud and related counts; the YC page spelling differs, so treated as likely the same person but not confirmed.

founders.name: Jazel Smith
founders.background_notes: Also board member at Democracy Builders per YC page.

exit.reason: Opening postponed April 2021 after founder charged; later fate not found.

competitors.name: Lambda School
competitors.what: YC backed income share agreement alternative to college

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly an operational and regulatory build (campus, online courses via Doral College, VR content), not hard technology.

defensibility.rationale: Depended on a borrowed campus, a partner's coursework and unsecured accreditation; no structural moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent reaction recorded; the project stalled on its own regulatory and legal problems.

market_need_then: College affordability was a documented problem; the plan assumed Pell Grants could cover tuition. VTDigger reports the program lacked state approval to grant degrees and was told in Aug 2020 to remove ads offering college credit.

identity.voice_and_tone: Program names like Freedom Year and Liberation Launch (VTDigger) signal an activist tone.

branding.brand_signature: Freedom Year and Liberation Launch program names

brand_strength.rationale: Local Vermont press covered it mainly because of the campus purchase and founder arrest; no evidence the name drove enrollment.

outcome_analysis: Degrees of Freedom planned a Pell Grant funded hybrid college on the former Marlboro College campus but never received state approval to grant degrees. On 27 April 2021 the Democracy Builders leader tied to the project was charged with financial crimes and the fall 2021 opening was shelved, with philanthropic funding unsecured. YC lists it inactive; no later opening was confirmed in the sources found.
notes: degreesoffreedom.org returned 503 so the site could not be checked. No funding rounds found (philanthropy funded, not equity). Lambda School is a loose analog from a 2019 article, not a direct rival. Education of founders not on the YC page. A 2021 article quoted a fall 2022 opening plan; no follow-up found. Cause of YC inactive status is an inference.
